svg.text: Firstmate now talks only to the T3 Code fork
Before: two ways to hand a worker its environment and first-party statement. After: one, and a T3 without it is refused up front.

g.text: Fork T3: environment and statement ride the thread launch

journal to restore it, and check Codex trust first
Stock T3, any other agent: refused
Fork T3: environment and statement ride the thread launch,
for every agent, Claude and Codex included

naming the T3 Code fork as the fix
Nothing is written into a worktree or home to carry them,
